description: This Java class defines an Android Fragment called AdvertiserFragment that manages Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) advertising. It provides UI controls to start and stop advertising, handles advertising failure notifications, and interacts with the AdvertiserService to control BLE advertising.

classes.name: AdvertiserFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that allows users to start and stop Bluetooth LE advertising, and handles advertising failure notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the BroadcastReceiver to handle advertising failure events.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and sets up the advertising toggle switch.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks if advertising is active and registers the failure receiver.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters the failure receiver to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: getServiceIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent to start or stop the AdvertiserService.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles toggle switch clicks to start or stop advertising.

methods.name: startAdvertising
methods.description: Starts BLE advertising by starting the AdvertiserService.

methods.name: stopAdvertising
methods.description: Stops BLE advertising by stopping the AdvertiserService.
